content:
As Amazon's fall Prime Day event officially kicks off, now is one of the best times to pick up a new pair of AirPods. While we haven't yet seen holiday-level discounts on Apple's latest AirPods 5 lineup, since the AirPods Pro 3 has dropped to such a low price, it may be a better buy for most people. And for those wanting to experience Apple's over-ear headphones, the 2026 AirPods Max 2 is currently $120 off across all five colors.

  • AirPods Pro 3: $179 (was $249)
  • AirPods Max 2: $429 (was $549)

I'm personally quite surprised that Apple launched the all-new entry-level AirPods 5 with active noise cancellation at the same $129 price point, since the previous generation sold for this amount without ANC. However, if you want the wireless charging case, you'll need to upgrade to the $149 version. When you do the math, that price is just $30 more for a much more capable, higher-end AirPods Pro, and I don't think it's even a question.

Originally $249, now $70 off—just $10 above Amazon's all-time low price, a price we've only ever recorded once since the product launched.

Looking ahead, the AirPods 5 lineup will almost certainly fall to near $100 or lower as a starting price, but based on past records and experience with the previous generation, it likely won't dip below that $99 threshold until sometime in 2027. And even if it does reach that price point, the AirPods Pro 3 still offers 3x better noise cancellation, longer battery life, a built-in heart rate sensor, all the hearing aid features, and I think a better fit as well.

These reasons alone are enough to choose the AirPods Pro 3 over the new 5 lineup. But if it's Apple's premium over-ear headphones you have your heart set on, then the deals on the 2026 Max 2 during fall Prime Day are right up your alley.

It's currently just $30 above Amazon's all-time low, all five colors are available, and there's a $120 discount to be had.

It's worth noting that since this product launched earlier this year, this is only the second time we've seen it drop to this price, with only one previous instance being lower than this.

Top brands like Sony and Bose have other headphone deals worth checking out (you can find them below), but in my eyes, the personal listening experience designed in Cupertino is simply irreplaceable. If you're not completely sold, you'll find some solid other options below, along with a range of standout deals from across the Apple ecosystem.
